meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: Claude 会把 Flask/Django/FastAPI 应用部署到 Azure App Service Linux;资源缺失时会自动创建,按框架设置启动命令;部署完不做健康检查,只输出部署后提示。
howto.when: 当你说“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”等,或说“deploy Python to App Service”时触发。

say.text: 把 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 资源缺失会先创建,然后部署。

say.text: 把 Django 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 项目有 azure.yaml 时会走 azd 部署路径。

say.text: 把 FastAPI 应用部署到 Azure App Service(Linux)
say.note: 会设置 uvicorn 启动命令再部署。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. Creates the resource group, plan, or web app if missing and sets startup command by framework, then deploys. Does no health checks after deploy; prints a post-deploy message and ends.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone says “Flask App Service”, “Django App Service”, etc., or asks to “deploy Python to App Service”.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service.
Deploy my Django app to Azure App Service.
say_en.note: Uses the azd path if azure.yaml is present.

say_en.text: Deploy the FastAPI app to Azure App Service Linux.
say_en.note: Sets the uvicorn startup command first.
